resolution.question: Will Harborview Credit Union's security team approve or reject analyst Dev Patel's software-exception request within their published five-business-day service window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the security team formally approved or rejected the request (i.e., a decision is recorded in the ticketing system) before 2026-08-17T17:00:00-08:00. Resolve NO if no decision is recorded by that cutoff.
